opponents.name: Wren of the Hedgerow
opponents.tagline: Raises an army from the garden wall.

lines.intro: Mind the hedge. It bites back.
lines.bigPlay: Out of the garden, all of you!
lines.lowLife: Hold the wall. Just hold it.
lines.win: The garden keeps its gate. Come back any time.
lines.lose: Fair. I'll grow a taller wall.
lines.nemesis: You again. The hedge remembers you.

opponents.name: Brother Odo
opponents.tagline: Collects tithes, mostly in life points.

lines.intro: Every spell has a price. I'll collect.
lines.bigPlay: A small tithe, if you please.
lines.lowLife: The collection plate is looking thin.
lines.win: Your offering is received. Go in peace.

opponents.name: Pip Kettlewhistle
opponents.tagline: Small, loud, and fond of large animals.

lines.intro: Hope you like big animals!
lines.lowLife: Uh oh. Uh oh. UH OH.
lines.lose: Aww. My wurm needs a nap now.
lines.nemesis: Back for more? I've been sharpening the siege engines.

opponents.name: Marisol Tidecaller
opponents.tagline: Waits for the tide, then brings it in.

lines.intro: The tide's out. For now.
lines.lowLife: Even the sea runs dry sometimes.

opponents.name: Ilse Vantorre
opponents.tagline: Turns your plans into her monsters.

lines.intro: Show me your plan. I'll improve it.
lines.win: Your plan was good. Mine was yours, but bigger.
lines.lose: Clever. I'll be studying this one.

opponents.name: Captain Hask
opponents.tagline: Drills the line until it charges as one.

lines.intro: Line up! On my mark!

opponents.name: The Lantern Widow
opponents.tagline: Every candle she lights, one of yours goes out.

lines.intro: I've lit a candle for you.
lines.nemesis: I knew you'd return. They always do.

opponents.name: Grondel Two-Axes
opponents.tagline: Has never once blocked.

lines.intro: Blocking is for cowards. Let's go.

opponents.name: Korvath the Patient
opponents.tagline: Answers everything, then waits.

lines.intro: No hurry. I have all the time you don't.
lines.win: I told you there was no hurry.
lines.lose: Well played. I'll wait for the next one.

opponents.name: Aldous Brightwing
opponents.tagline: One hero, every blessing at once.

lines.intro: For glory, and for a good show.
lines.lowLife: Heroes fall. Then they get up.
lines.lose: The song will remember you, friend.

opponents.name: Seraphine Ashmark
opponents.tagline: Wins before the second cup of tea.

lines.intro: I'll be quick. You won't feel a thing.
lines.lowLife: Ashes come back. So do I.
lines.win: Over already? I barely warmed up.
lines.nemesis: Last time was a warm-up. This one counts.

opponents.name: Mirela Nightcourt
opponents.tagline: The court is always hungry.

lines.intro: Welcome to my court. Do stay.
lines.bigPlay: Someone has to be the sacrifice.
lines.win: Thank you for coming. Your life was delicious.
lines.nemesis: The aristocrats saved you a seat. Front row.

opponents.name: Kestrel Ashe
opponents.tagline: A rival with a chip on her shoulder.

lines.intro: Name's Kestrel. You're the new one everyone keeps beating. Let's see if it sticks.
lines.lose: Huh. Fine. I'll be back sharper, with a better grudge.

rival.before: Name's Kestrel. You're the new one everyone keeps beating. Let's see if it sticks.
rival.after: Huh. Fine. I'll be back sharper, with a better grudge.

opponents.name: Kestrel Ashe
opponents.tagline: The rival, playing sharper.

lines.intro: Told you I'd be back. Same deck, a lot more practice.
lines.lose: You keep doing that. I keep learning. Next tier, then.

rival.before: Told you I'd be back. Same deck, a lot more practice.
rival.after: You keep doing that. I keep learning. Next tier, then.

opponents.name: Kestrel Ashe
opponents.tagline: The rival, out for blood.

lines.intro: Champion tier. I skipped meals to tune this one.
lines.lose: ...Okay. You're good. That doesn't mean you get to keep winning.

rival.before: Champion tier. I skipped meals to tune this one.
rival.after: ...Okay. You're good. That doesn't mean you get to keep winning.

opponents.name: Kestrel Ashe
opponents.tagline: The rival's last stand.

lines.intro: Last time, I promise. Everything I've got, every card I wanted.
lines.lose: Well played. Really. Buy you a coffee? I'll still want a rematch.

rival.before: Last time, I promise. Everything I've got, every card I wanted.
rival.after: Well played. Really. Buy you a coffee? I'll still want a rematch.

opponents.name: Vesna the Unbowed
opponents.tagline: Energy, tempo and no apologies.

lines.intro: Charge up. This won't take long.

opponents.name: Thaddeus Grail
opponents.tagline: Answers first, questions never.

lines.intro: Go ahead. Cast something.

opponents.name: Orla of the Thousand
opponents.tagline: Where there's one elf, there's a forest.

lines.intro: We are many. You are one.
lines.win: The forest grows back. You don't.

opponents.name: The Null Engine
opponents.tagline: It doesn't think. It computes.

lines.intro: PROCESS: OPPONENT. RESULT: PENDING.

timed.message: Phase two: the Null Engine overclocks and draws two.
Phase three: the Null Engine's constructs grow stronger.

opponents.name: Saint Adela
opponents.tagline: The dungeon is hers; you're only visiting.

lines.intro: Kneel, or be knelt upon.

timed.message: Saint Adela's second wind: she gains 5 life.

opponents.name: The Leviathan
opponents.tagline: A raid boss: 100 life and three phases. Bring everything.

lines.intro: The deep stirs. Something vast rises.

timed.message: Phase two: the Leviathan surfaces and draws two.
Phase three: a spawn of the deep joins the fight.
Final phase: the Leviathan's brood grows stronger.
